integrity: Exact formulas proved by elementary transfer-operator identities and corroborated by standalone rational cylinder integration; no independent audit or certification.
scientific_limitations: Stationary centered-coordinate cubic correlations of finite full-branch affine maps; does not prove full time reversibility or generalize to non-covering or nonlinear maps; possible previously implicit polynomial-transfer derivation and unindexed historical priority remain unresolved.
title: Exact third-order correlations distinguish full-branch interval maps with identical linear and quadratic autocorrelations
